playwright.description: Browser automation for visual testing and UI regression evidence. Use for: Flutter web build screenshots, responsive checks, visual smoke tests. Requires a running web target (e.g. flutter run -d chrome).

context7.description: Up-to-date library docs lookup. Use for: Flutter, Dart, Material 3, Riverpod, camera plugin, tflite_flutter / TFLite docs.

codegraph.description: Semantic code intelligence. Use for: callers/callees, tracing call chains, impact analysis on camera/inference, symbol lookup across lib/.

ruflo.description: Multi-agent orchestration and project memory. Use for: swarm coordination, agent spawning, memory_store/memory_search, hook routing.
